437:t_1:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「Wake up, $n. You can see $$翠の地球$$ so beautifully from here.」

437:t_1:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「This is no time to be sleeping, man. Pretty soon we'll be fighting the $$新地球皇国$$ on $$蒼の地球$$, you know.」

437:t_1:9.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Keep trying to call out to him.」

437:t_1:11.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「There's no damage to the brain. Right now $n is only in a deep sleep.」

437:t_1:13.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I heard that if both eyes become those eyes stained with blood, the mind dies...」

437:t_1:14.en:
$$フェルト$$
「$$刹那$$... Is $n never going to wake up again?」

437:t_1:16.en:
$$刹那$$
「It is not the $$スフィアの反作用$$... I think $n's mind collapsed because too many shocking things happened in a row.」

437:t_1:17.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If the backlash stalls halfway between hope and despair, then it means he has fallen into despair right now, doesn't it...」

437:t_1:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「The fight against $$アドヴェント#pilot$$... and the matter of $$マキ#pilot$$, huh...」

437:t_1:20.en:
$$カレン$$
「You little...! Do you have any idea what kind of situation this is!?」

437:t_1:21.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I think I do, though.」

437:t_1:22.en:
$$カレン$$
「You don't understand! How much despair $n has fought through, and is sinking into right now!」

437:t_1:23.en:
$$ティティ$$
「But it's the truth. I thought $n was a much more amazing kid than this. What a letdown.」

437:t_1:25.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Stop it, $$カレン$$. ...You too, $$ティティ$$.」

437:t_1:27.en:
$$甲児$$
「...Hey, $$ティティ$$... You talked with $$マキ#pilot$$ at the $$ターミナル・ベース$$, didn't you?」

437:t_1:28.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Yeah... She told me all sorts of things about $n from when he was going to school.」

437:t_1:29.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Was there anything unusual about her at the time?」

437:t_1:31.en:
$$アルト$$
「Like a cunning attempt to deceive us, or some unnatural behavior from a guilty conscience...」

437:t_1:32.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Nothing like that. If anything, she seemed to be having fun.」

437:t_1:34.en:
$$さやか$$
「Was she happy about being free...?」

437:t_1:35.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'll ask her directly the next time I see her.」

437:t_1:36.en:
$$カレン$$
「Why she's with $$クロノ$$, and whether she got close to $n knowing about him or not.」

437:t_1:37.en:
$$アマタ$$
「But $$クロウ$$ and $$ランド$$ said something, you know.」

437:t_1:38.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Going by how that guy $$ブルー$$ acted, the unit members too never imagined they'd end up fighting us until that moment... is what they said.」

437:t_1:39.en:
$$刹那$$
「Then $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ decided it on the spot.」

437:t_1:40.en:
$$フェルト$$
「And they carried it out without raising a single doubt...」

437:t_1:41.en:
$$甲児$$
「We don't even know what $$クロノ$$ is after, and now even the Reformists we thought were on our side have come to this...」

437:t_1:42.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「At this point, the only one we can count on is $$クィーン$$, who calls herself the third $$クロノ$$.」

437:t_1:43.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$フェルト$$... Has there been any contact from $$クィーン$$ since then?」

437:t_1:44.en:
$$フェルト$$
「No. She has such a vast intelligence network that I'd think she knows about our movements too, though...」

437:t_1:45.en:
$$アルト$$
「So all we can do is wait...? For $$クィーン$$, and for $n...」

437:t_1:49.en: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Captain's Cabin ～

437:t_1:50.en:
$$宗介$$
「...That concludes the report on $c's actions on the southern front of the Central Continent.」

437:t_1:52.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The $$霊子吸収システム$$, Miss $$スズネ$$'s assault, the truth about $$ジェニオン$$... One shock after another, isn't it.」

437:t_1:53.en:
$$宗介$$
「However, the unit's morale is high, and including the power-up of the three Reactors, I believe there is no major problem for our strategy from here on.」

437:t_1:54.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Strategically, that may be true, but...」

437:t_1:56.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Isn't what happened to $l a shock for you as well, $$相良$$, and for the rest of his friends...?」

437:t_1:58.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I hear $$カレン$$ and the others have stayed at the sickroom the whole time. And you too, $$相良$$...」

437:t_1:61.en:
$$宗介$$
「...During the $$時獄戦役$$, I too fell into the worst of situations.」

437:t_1:62.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That was in Hong Kong, wasn't it.」

437:t_1:63.en:
$$宗介$$
「It may be unreasonable to compare myself with the present $n, but I believe $n will overcome this wall.」

437:t_1:64.en:
$$宗介$$
「He is a man who can find hope within himself.」

437:t_1:65.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Is that true of you as well, $$相良$$?」

437:t_1:66.en:
$$宗介$$
「What do you mean by that...?」

437:t_1:67.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Are you, $$相良$$, also fighting despair, the same way $l is?」

437:t_1:69.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm sorry. That was far too tactless of me.」

437:t_1:70.en:
$$宗介$$
「No... please do not worry about it.」

437:t_1:71.en:
$$宗介$$
「...With $$千鳥$$ abducted, $$アル$$ lost, $$ミスリル$$ destroyed, and $$アマルガム$$ in league with the Empire and continuing to rise...」

437:t_1:72.en:
$$宗介$$
「The situation surrounding me can only be called hopeless.」

437:t_1:74.en:
$$宗介$$
「That is my intention. That sort of thing I fed to the dogs a long time ago.」

437:t_1:76.en:
$$宗介$$
「$n is surely the same. ...I don't know what the despair at the bottom of his heart really is, but he is a strong man.」

437:t_1:77.en:
$$宗介$$
「With just a little more... a small trigger, he will wake up and be able to fight as he did before.」

437:t_1:78.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You believe in him, don't you... And in rescuing $$カナメ$$.」

437:t_1:80.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Thank you, $$相良$$. Your words help me firm up my own resolve.」

437:t_1:82.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I will do my best too. Take back the Earth, save $$カナメ$$, defeat $$アマルガム$$...」

437:t_1:83.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And settle things with my brother...」

437:t_1:85.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'll be borrowing your strength too, $$相良$$. May I ask that of you?」
